A “Setu” coin with a bull on the obverse: Chelete ea tšepe ea "Setu" e nang le poho ka thoko. Lentsoe Setu - borokho ba ho ea Lanka, Rameswaram - le hlaha licheleteng tsa tšepe tsa babusi ba morao-rao ba Tamil ba 'muso oa Jaffna; poho ea setulo, Nandi ea Shiva, ke sesebelisoa sa bona se tloaelehileng.
A burial urn of the kind that made Adich: Moqomo oa lepato oa mofuta o entseng hore Adichanallur a tume. Bafu - kapa masapo a bona a bokelletsoeng - ba ne ba kenngoa ka har'a metsu e joalo le thepa ea mabitla 'me ba patoa mobung o nang le lehlohlojane ka holim'a Thamirabarani. Li-urns ke sehokelo se tobileng முதுமக்கள் தாழி tsa lithothokiso tsa Sangam.
A catalogue of the coins issued by the C: Lethathamo la lichelete tsa tšepe tse fanoeng ke marena a Chera, Chola le Pandya, hammoho le litšoantšetso tsa tsona tsa borena tsa seqha, nkoe le litlhapi.
A ceramic vessel from Adichanallur. Smal: Sekepe sa ceramic se tsoang Adichanallur. Lipitsa tse nyenyane tse kang tsena li ne li behoa ka hare kapa ka thōko ho mabitla, mohlomong li tšoere lijo, metsi kapa linyehelo bakeng sa bafu - pono ea tumelo ea Mehla ea Tšepe leetong le ka nģ'ane ho lefu.
A chariot for a creeper, a shawl for a p: Koloi bakeng sa sehahabi, shawl bakeng sa pikoko, litholoana tse phelisang bakeng sa seroki: limpho tse tummeng ka ho fetisisa tsa bareki li shebahala li sa sebetse, 'me ke eona ntlha ea bona. Kodai madam o fana ka seatla se bulehileng hoo mofani a sa baleng tšebeliso ea mpho - kutloelo-bohloko e fetisetsoang ho liphoofolo, limela le ho ithuta ka ho tšoanang.
A Chera coin in the collection of the Na: Chera ea tšepe ea Chera pokellong ea Musiamo oa Napier, Thiruvananthapuram. Lichelete tsa tšepe tsa Chera li na le seqha le motsu, e leng letšoao la lesika la borena, ’me mehlala e mengata ea pele e tsoa Karur, setsi sa Chera se Amaravathi.
A chieftain of the Ay line in the southe: Ke morena oa Ay line naheng e ka boroa ea maralla ea Podiyil (Pothigai). Neano e tsebahalang haholo e bua ka ha a nehelana ka seaparo sa bohlokoa ho molimo, eo ka tloaelo a tsejoang e le Shiva—ho fana e le boinehelo hammoho le ho fana.
A chieftain of the Malaiyaman lineage, o: Morena oa leloko la Malaiyaman, naheng e pota-potileng Mullur le Tirukkoyilur, o hopoloa ka mosa oa hae ho liroki le ho bohle ba tlang ho eena. Sebaka sa hae har’a batšehetsi ba supileng se bontša hore tlhompho ea ’musi e ne e lekanngoa ka ho fana ha hae ho lekanang le sebaka sa hae.
A Chola coin carrying Pandya royal insig: Chelete ea tšepe ea Chola e jereng letšoao la borena la Pandya. Ha Cholas e tlisa naha ea Pandya tlas'a puso ea bona, ba ile ba beha tlhapi ea Pandya haufi le nkoe ea bona - e leng letšoao la tlhōlo le entsoeng ka tšepe.
A city where literature, royal patronage: Toropo eo ho eona lingoliloeng, tšehetso ea borena, bolumeli le bophelo ba litoropo li 'nileng tsa kopana ka lilemo tse ka bang likete tse peli.
A coin of Kulottunga Chola bearing the t: Chelete ea tšepe ea Kulottunga Chola e nang le sehlooho se reng "Malai Nadu konda Chola" - BaChola ba nkileng naha e maralla, ke hore, naha ea Chera. Marena a Chola a ile a phatlalatsa tlhōlo ea bona ka litlotla tse betliloeng licheleteng tsa bona tsa tšepe hammoho le tse betliloeng mengolong ea bona.
A coin of Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), w: Chelete ea tšepe ea Kulottunga I (1070–1120 CE), e ileng ea kopanya mela ea Chola le Chalukya ea Bochabela 'me ea busa e' ngoe ea puso e telele ka ho fetisisa le e atlehileng ka ho fetisisa ea Chola. Lichelete tsa hae tsa tšepe li ntšetsa pele mefuta ea Chola e thehiloeng ka lebitso la hae ka Nagari.
A coin of Rajaraja I. His copper coins o: Chelete ea tšepe ea Rajaraja I. Lichelete tsa hae tsa tšepe tsa koporo tsa mofuta oa morena ea emeng le ea lutseng, tse hlahisitsoeng ka mor'a hore a hlōle leboea la Sri Lanka, li ile tsa potoloha ka ho pharaletseng ka mahlakoreng a mabeli a leoatle 'me tsa etsisoa ka makholo a lilemo.
A coin of the Jaffna kingdom showing a h: Chelete ea tšepe ea 'muso oa Jaffna e bontšang pere e nang le litlhapi. Marena a Tamil a Jaffna (13th-17th century) a ile a fana ka lichelete tsa tšepe moetlong oa India Boroa, sehopotso sa likamano tse haufi le Palk Strait.
A coin of the Kongu Cheras, the Chera li: Chelete ea tšepe ea Kongu Cheras, mohala oa Chera o neng o busa naha ea Kongu e karolong e ka bophirimela ea Tamil (e haufi le Coimbatore ea kajeno, Erode le Karur) - sebaka se le seng se hlahisitseng lichelete tse ngata tsa tšepe tsa Roma.
A crowned, moustached figure in profile,: Sebopeho sa moqhaka, se nang le litelu se setle, se apereng baki ea mabenyane le lituku tse phallang, se phahamisa basebetsi ba masiba. Sefahleho le matsoho li huloa ka moleng o motle o motšo mobung o mosehla 'me liaparo li hlatsoitsoe ka ocher, pinki le botala - thuto e kang setšoantšo sa moaparo oa lekhotla setšoantšong sa tempele.
A detail of the painted ceiling of the J: Lintlha tse mabapi le siling e pentiloeng ea sehalalelo sa lehaha la Jain ho Sittanavasal: li-lotus tse pinki tse bulehang har'a mapheo a matala, phoofolo e phunyang metsing le setšoantšo se bokellang lipalesa. Letamo le atisa ho baloa e le sebaka sa lotus moat sa samavasarana, kopano ea leholimo moo Jain Tirthankara a rutang teng, ka lipalesa tse bokellang tse tšepahalang ho fana ka tsona.
A funerary vessel from the burial cairns: Sekepe sa lepato se tsoang lithabeng tsa lepato tsa maralla a Nilgiri, sekoaelo sa sona se koahetsoe ke litšoantšo tse entsoeng ka mohlala. Baepolli ba lekholong la bo19 la lilemo ba li-cairns tsa Nilgiri ba ile ba fumana likoahelo tse ngata tse joalo tse nang le batho, liphoofolo le bapalami - litšoantšo tse nyenyane tsa letsopa tse ka bontšang bophelo le boemo ba bafu.
A garland of about a hundred and fifty a: Kharebe ea litemana tsa akam tse ka bang lekholo le mashome a mahlano ka Kanimethaviyar, tse ling tse mashome a mararo bakeng sa sebaka se seng le se seng sa libaka tse hlano.
A gold coin of Rajaraja I (985–1014 CE),: Chelete ea tšepe ea khauta ea Rajaraja I (985-1014 CE), sehahi sa tempele e kholo ea Thanjavur. E bonts'a lets'oao la borena la Chola: nkoe e lutseng e pota-potiloe ke litlhapi tse peli tsa Pandya, ka tlas'a parasol ea bobusi, e nang le lebitso la morena Nagari - ba Chola ba ipolela hore ba busa boroa.
A gold half-kahavanu of Virarajendra Cho: Half-kahavanu ea khauta ea Virarajendra Chola (1063-1070 CE). Kahavanu (ho tloha kakapana) e ne e le mokhatlo oa khauta oa Sri Lanka, 'me khauta ea Chola e ileng ea otla ho fihlela tekanyo ena e bonahatsa nako ea puso ea Chola sehlekehlekeng seo.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiya: Thothokiso ea tataiso ea li-Idyll tse Leshome ka Kadiyalur Uruthirankananar. Bard e nang le yazh e kholo e tataisoa ho Thondaiman Ilanthiraiyan oa Kanchi; tseleng thothokiso ena e taka litšoantšo tse hlakileng tsa metse, likou le batho.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Mudath: Leboko la tataiso la li-Idyll tse Leshome ka Mudathama Kanniyar. Sebapa sa ho letsa meropa (porunar) se ileng sa putsoa haholo se tataisa sehlopha se seng ho morena oa Chola ea mosa Karikal Valavan.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Nallur: Thothokiso ea tataiso ea li-Idyll tse Leshome ka Nallur Nathathanar. Bard e bapalang yazh e nyenyane (harepa) e isa e 'ngoe ho morenana Nalliyakkodan, e hlalosang mathata a li-bard tse futsanehileng le mofuthu oa mohlokomeli ea seatla se bulehileng.
A guide poem of the Ten Idylls by Perunk: Thothokiso ea tataiso ea li-Idyll tse Leshome ka Perunkausikanar. Libapali tse sollang (koothar) li tataisoa ho morenana Nannan; thothokiso e ketekoa ka ho hapa melumo e mengata ea lithaba.
A large storage jar associated with Adic: Nkho e kholo ea polokelo e amanang le Adichanallur. Linkho tse khōlō li ne li tšetse lijo-thollo, metsi le lijo tse ling; libakeng tsa lepato, lijana tsa boholo bona li ne li ka boela tsa sebetsa e le urns. Lentsoe "dolio" le hopotsa dolium, nkho e kholo ea polokelo ea lefatše la Roma.
A large, round-bellied funerary urn from: Mokokotlo o moholo, o chitja oa funerary o tsoang Adichanallur. Li-urn tse kang tsena li ne li ka ema li le telele ho feta tsa ngoana, ’me ho li etsa ho ne ho hloka tsebo e khōlō: Liroki tsa Sangam li bua le sebōpi se entseng lipitsa tse kang கலம்செய் கோவே — “Oho morena har’a libōpi”.
A lead coin from Andipatti bearing a leg: Chelete ea pele e tsoang ho Andipatti e nang le tšōmo ka Tamil-Brahmi. Ntle ho marena a mararo a roetseng meqhaka, marenana a sebaka sa mehleng ea Sangam a ile a ntša lichelete tsa tšepe tse nang le loto le koporo, ’me litšōmo tsa Setamil-Brahmi tse holim’a tsona li thusa ho beha mabitso ho babusi bana.
A line drawing of the vimana and a pilla: Setšoantšo sa linea sa vimana le holo ea litšiea tsa Tempele ea Brihadisvara.
A love poem of the Ten Idylls by Kapilar: Thothokiso ea lerato ea li-Idyll tse Leshome ka Kapilar, e behiloeng sebakeng sa thaba (kurinji). Neano e re e ngoletsoe ho ruta morena oa leboea botle ba lithothokiso tsa lerato tsa Tamil; e tumme ka mabitso a dipalesa tse mashome a robong a metso e robong.
A modern artist’s imagining of a busy ha: Monahano oa moetsi oa sejoale-joale oa kou e phetheselang ea likepe, limmaraka le litora, kamora litlhaloso tsa Silappathikaram le Pattinappalai. Hase bopaki ba hore na ha e le hantle motse oo o ne o shebahala joang.
A modern sketch imagining ships and buil: Sekeche sa sejoale-joale se nahanang ka likepe le meaho boema-kepeng ba khale. Joalo ka tokiso e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea Puhar, e hlalosa litlhaloso tsa lingoliloeng; sebopeho se felletseng sa boemakepe ha se tsejoe.
A name linked with Nedunalvadai and Tiru: Lebitso le amanang le Nedunalvadai le Tirumurukarruppatai ho li-Idyll tse Leshome - leha e ka ba la liroki tse fetang bonngoe ka linako tse fapaneng. Hamorao tšōmo e bua ka ho hana ha hae ho fana ka kahlolo ea hae ea thothokiso esita le ho Shiva lekhotleng la Pandya: letšoao la sebete sa kelello, eseng ketsahalo ea histori.
A palm-leaf manuscript from the museum’s: Buka e ngotsoeng ka letsoho ea lekhasi la palema e tsoang pokellong ea musiamo.
A Pandya coin of the “massa” type. Massa: Chelete ea tšepe ea Pandya ea mofuta oa "massa". Massa ke lebitso le fuoeng lichelete tsa tšepe tsa medieval tsa koporo tse bontšang setšoantšo se emeng ka lehlakoreng le leng le setšoantšo se lutseng ka lehlakoreng le leng - mofuta o phatlalalitsoeng ke Cholas 'me o tsoela pele ke Pandyas le marena a Sri Lanka.
A Pandya coin showing a standing king wi: Chelete ea tšepe ea Pandya e bontšang morena ea emeng ea tšoereng letšoao la tlhapi. Setšoantšo sa 'musi ea emeng, ea tsejoang ke chelete ea tšepe ea koporo ea Chola, e ile ea nkoa ke Pandyas ha matla a bona a tsosolosoa lekholong la bo13 la lilemo.
A Pandya coin with the twin fish and a b: Chelete ea tšepe ea Pandya e nang le tlhapi ea mafahla le poho. Litlhapi tse kopantsoeng li ile tsa fetoha letšoao le tšoarellang la Pandya, le betliloeng lifolakhang tsa Madurai tsa lithothokiso 'me tsa otla licheleteng tsa tšepe ka lilemo tse fetang sekete.
A pipeline of terracotta rings, set one: Phaephe ea mehele ea terracotta, e behiloeng ka holim'a e 'ngoe ka mekhahlelo e mene, e pepesitsoe ho chekoa ha Korkai. Liphaephe tsa letsopa tse chesitsoeng le liliba tse kang tsena li ne li tsamaisa metsi a bile a tšoloha litoropong tsa naha ea khale ea khale ea Tamil - karolo ea boenjiniere ba letsatsi le letsatsi boema-kepeng bo phetheselang.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Kadiyalur Ur: Thothokiso ea Li-Idyll Tse Leshome ea Kadiyalur Uruthirankannanar, e rorisang morena oa Chola Karikal Valavan le toropo ea hae e phetheselang ea kou ea Kaveripoompattinam (Puhar), ka likepe tsa eona, limmaraka le mekete.
A poem of the Ten Idylls by Nakkeerar. D: Thothokiso ea li-Idyll tse Leshome ka Nakkeerar. Nakong ea moea o molelele o batang oa leboea oa mariha, mofumahali o labalabela monna oa hae ha morena a ntse a hlokometse masole a hae a lemetseng kampong ea ntoa.
A portrait coin of the Chera king Kuttuv: Chelete ea tšepe ea setšoantšo sa morena oa Chera Kuttuvan Kotai, a mo reha ka Tamil-Brahmi. Ka lichelete tsa tšepe tsa Makkotai, litaba tsena tse sa tloaelehang tsa silevera - mohlomong li susumelitsoe ke lichelete tsa tšepe tsa Roma tse fihlang ka khoebo - ke tse ling tsa lichelete tsa pele tsa India tse bontšang sefahleho sa 'musi.
A potsherd inscribed in Tamil-Brahmi, fo: Letlapa le ngotsoeng ka Setamil-Brahmi, le fumanoeng Tissamaharama ka boroa ho Sri Lanka 'me le ngotsoe hoo e ka bang lekholong la bobeli la lilemo BCE. Ho ngola ka Setamil ka lipitsa tsa letsopa hole le naha ea Tamil ho bonts'a bahoebi ba Tamil ba sebetsa mose ho maoatle mehleng ea khale ea nalane.
A rare book from the first decades of Ta: Buka e sa tloaelehang ho tloha lilemong tse mashome tsa pele tsa khatiso ea Setamil, ha litemana tsa khale tse bolokiloeng makhasing a palema li ne li ngoloa ka lekhetlo la pele.
A rare volume digitised from CICT’s arch: Molumo o sa tloaelehang o kentsoeng polokelong ea litaba ea CICT 'me oa bolokeloa ho ithutoa. Lintlha tse felletseng tsa lethathamo la libuka li tla eketsoa ke bahlokomeli ba musiamo.
A Sangam-age Chola coin with a tiger and: Chelete ea tšepe ea Sangam-age Chola e nang le nkoe le tlou. Lichelete tsa pele tsa Chola, haholo-holo tsa koporo, li le bohareng ba nkoe - letšoao le tšoanang leo Cholas ea borena e neng e tla le nka lilemo tse sekete hamorao. Uraiyur le Kaveripoompattinam e ne e le litsi tsa bona tse kholo.
A Sangam-age Pandya coin, typically a sm: Chelete ea tšepe ea Pandya ea mehleng ea Sangam, eo hangata e leng sekwere se senyenyane sa koporo se nang le tlou ka lehlakoreng le leng le tlhapi e entsoeng ka setaele ka lehlakoreng le leng. Lichelete tse joalo tsa tšepe li ne li potoloha Madurai le haufi le eona, motse-moholo oa Pandya o ketekoang Maduraikkanchi.
A scholarly study of government, adminis: Boithuto ba borutehi ba mmuso, tsamaiso, le bophelo ba sechaba naheng ea Tamil ea mehleng ea Sangam.
A second coin of the Kongu Cheras. Compa: Chelete ea tšepe ea bobeli ea Kongu Cheras. Bapisa tse peli: lichelete tsa tšepe tse otloang ka letsoho lia fapana ho ea ka seteraeke, ho aparoa le ho sehoa, 'me liphapang tse joalo li thusa batho ba nang le bo-numismatists ho rarolla mathata le ho fumana hore na lichelete tsa tšepe li lutse nako e kae.
A second image of the four-armed, seated: Setšoantšo sa bobeli sa ba hlometseng ba bane, ba lutseng Ganesha. Bapisa likarolo tsa eona, mekhabiso le ho fetoha ha kutu le ea pele: ka har'a canon e arolelanoang ea Silpa Sastras, moetsi e mong le e mong oa litšoantšo le workshop o ile a tlohela ho ama ha hae.
A selection drawn from the Thirukkural,: Khetho e nkiloeng ho Thirukkural, e bokellang li-couplets tse sa lebaleheng bakeng sa babali.
A separate photographing of the opening: Setšoantšo se arohaneng sa makhasi a qalang a bundle 579 D, Maduraikkanchi.
Mohalaleli oa Shaiva, matsoho a kopane borapeling. Marena a Chola a ile a hlompha Ma-Nayanmar a mashome a tšeletseng a metso e meraro, bao Sekkizhar a ileng a bua ka bophelo ba bona ho Periya Puranam, ’me litšoantšo tsa bona tsa boronse li ne li hlongoa litempeleng ’me li nkoa ka mekoloko ea mekete.
A sherd illustrated in Vimala Begley’s 1: Sherd e bontšitsoeng thutong ea 1983 ea Vimala Begley ea ho ratana ha Arikamedu. Ha a hlahloba hape likarolo tse epolotsoeng, Begley o ile a pheha khang ea hore sebaka sa bolulo se qalile bohareng ba lekholo la boraro la lilemo BCE - pele ho moo Mortimer Wheeler a neng a rerile - ka likamano tsa Mediterranean ho elella bofelong ba lekholo la bobeli la lilemo BCE. Matsatsi a hae e ntse e le tlhaloso ea litsebi.
A sherd of an urn found in 2004, decorat: Sekhahla sa urn se fumanoeng ka 2004, se khabisitsoeng ka setlolo se sebelisitsoeng se nang le setšoantšo sa basali se emeng har'a litšoantšo tse atisang ho baloa e le mahlaka a paddy, likhama, crane le koena. Litsebi li bone ho eena molimotsana oa pele oa 'mè - ba bang, joalokaha filimi e bolela, selelekela sa Kotravai, molimotsana oa ntoa oa lithothokiso tsa Sangam. Ke e 'ngoe ea litšoantšo tse sa tloaelehang tsa Iron Age Tamil Nadu.
A short illustrated guide for visitors:: Tataiso e khutšoane e nang le litšoantšo bakeng sa baeti: hore na lithothokiso tsa Sangam ke eng, li hlophisoa joang, le hore na lithothokiso tsa akam le tsa puram le libaka tse hlano tsa naha li sebetsa joang.
A silver kasu of Rajendra Chola combinin: Kasu ea silevera ea Rajendra Chola e kopanyang litšoantšetso tsa borena - nkoe ea Chola le tlhapi ea Pandya le seqha sa Chera. Rajendra I (1014-1044 CE) o ile a isa matla a Chola ho ea Ganges le ka mose ho leoatle ho ea Asia Boroa-bochabela, 'me lichelete tsa hae tsa tšepe li phatlalatsa bobusi ba hae ba meqhaka eohle e meraro ea Tamil.
A silver kasu of the “Uttama” type, attr: Kasu ea silevera ea mofuta oa "Uttama", e boleloang mona ho Rajendra I. Mofuta ona o nka lebitso la oona licheleteng tsa tšepe tsa Uttama Chola, eo moqapi oa eona - nkoe, tlhapi le seqha ka tlas'a parasol - e beha mohlala oa silevera ea Chola hamorao.
A simplified sequence of how cloth is ma: Tatelano e nolofalitsoeng ea hore na lesela le etsoa joang. E hlalosa mokhoa o akaretsang; ha se bopaki ba hore workshop e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ea khale ea Tamil e latetse mehato ena hantle ka tatellano ena - lisebelisoa, le tatellano ea ho daea le ho loha, e ka fapana.
A small pottery cup from the Adichanallu: Mohope o monyane oa letsopa o tsoang mabitleng a Adichanallur. Likopi, likotlolo le likhurumetso e ne e le tse ling tsa thepa e tloaelehileng ea mabitla, ’me ka hloko, esita le libōpeho tsa tsona li bontša tsebo ea libōpi tse sebetsang holim’a lebili lilemong tse ka bang likete tse tharo tse fetileng.
A summit of Chola architecture, art and: Seboka sa boqapi ba Chola, bonono le tsamaiso; karolo ea UNESCO Great Living Chola Temples.
A temple gopuram over a Madurai street: Gopuram ea tempele holim'a seterata sa Madurai
A vast open-air relief carved across two: Setšoantšo se seholo se bulehileng se betliloeng majoeng a mabeli, a tsejoang e le Koko ea Arjuna kapa The Descent of the Ganga, se bontša melimo, ba bohlale, liphoofolo le lelapa la litlou tse boholo ba bophelo ba phuthehela lefarung la tlhaho.
A village on the Noyyal in Erode distric: Motse o Noyyal seterekeng sa Erode, o chekiloeng e le setsi sa ho etsa lifaha, ho sebetsa ka lehakoe le tlhahiso ea tšepe le tšepe.
A Visitor’s Guide to Sangam Literature: Tataiso ea Baeti ho Lingoliloeng tsa Sangam
A volume connected with the Madurai Tami: Molumo o amanang le Madurai Tamil Sangam, sekolo sa bongoli se thehiloeng Madurai ka 1901 ke Pandithurai Thevar 'me hangata se bitsoa "Fourth Tamil Sangam".
A volume from the shrine’s collection of: Bolumo e tsoang pokellong ea tempele ea liphetolelo tsa Thirukkural. Molaetsa oa bokhabane oa Kural o fihlile ho babali ka lipuo tse ngata tsa Maindia le tsa lefatše.
A volume on the poetry of Kambar, the gr: Molumo oa lithothokiso tsa Kambar, seroki se seholo sa Kamba Ramayanam (Ramavataram), eo tsebo ea hae ea Setamil e ileng ea mo fa tlotla ea "Kavichakravarthi", moemphera oa liroki.
A vyala or yali, the horned, lion-like g: A vyala kapa yali, sebata se nang le manaka, se kang tau sa litempele tsa India Boroa.
